message:
So the fuzzer:
1. Loads the font with `face_index = 0` and `instance_index` from 0 to `num_instances`.
2. When `instance_index > 0`, `tt_apply_mvar` is called.

So I need to create a TrueType font with:
1. A `fvar` table (for multiple masters / named instances)
2. A `gasp` table with version 0/1 and `numRanges = 0`
3. An `MVAR` table with a value record whose tag is `GASP0` (0x47415330) through `GASP9`
4. The font needs to have at least 1 named instance

Let me check what tables are needed. Let me look at how `FT_HAS_MULTIPLE_MASTERS` is determined and what `TT_Get_MM_Var` needs:

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2 && grep -n "FT_HAS_MULTIPLE_MASTERS" include/freetype/ftmm.h | head -5; echo "==="; grep -n "TTAG_fvar\|TTAG_gvar\|TTAG_MVAR\|TTAG_HVAR\|TTAG_gasp" src/truetype/ttgxvar.c src/sfnt/ttload.c src/sfnt/sfobjs.c | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2 && grep -n "FT_HAS_MULTIPLE_MASTERS" include/freetype/ftmm.h | head -5; echo "==="; grep -rn "TTAG_fvar\|TTAG_gvar\|TTAG_MVAR\|TTAG_HVAR\|TTAG_gasp" src/truetype/ttgxvar.c src/sfnt/ttload.c src/sfnt/sfobjs.c | head -20</parameter>
